components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default next-action button for standard app screens.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The supporting action button for navigation, filters, and alternate controls.

components.name: Settings Deck Button
components.description: Compact clipped-corner action style used inside the neon settings deck.
components.css: .ds-settings-button { min-height: 34px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--settings-active-accent, #18ddff) 70%, #ffffff); border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 9px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--settings-active-accent, #18ddff), color-mix(in srgb, var(--settings-active-accent, #18ddff) 58%, #ffffff)); color: #06101c; font-family: 'Barlow Semi Condensed', 'Sora Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.07em; text-transform: uppercase; clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 8px) 0, 100% 8px, 100% 100%, 8px 100%, 0 calc(100% - 8px)); box-shadow: 0 0 26px color-mix(in srgb, var(--settings-active-accent, #18ddff) 36%, transparent); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-settings-button:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 0 30px color-mix(in srgb, var(--settings-active-accent, #18ddff) 26%, transparent); } .ds-settings-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--settings-active-accent, #18ddff) 78%, #ffffff); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Default form field for light and warm panels.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: var(--color-text, #241f1a); font-family: 'Sora Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field span { font-family: 'Barlow Semi Condensed', 'Sora Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-text-secondary, rgba(36, 31, 26, 0.56)); } .ds-field input { border: 1px solid var(--color-border, rgba(36, 31, 26, 0.12)); border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 12px; background: var(--color-input-bg, #fffaf4); color: var(--color-text, #241f1a); font: inherit; } .ds-field input:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent-glow, rgba(31, 61, 122, 0.4)); border-color: transparent; }

components.name: Panel Card
components.description: Standard lifted app panel for library, progress, lessons, and charts.
components.css: .ds-panel-card { border: 1px solid var(--color-border, rgba(36, 31, 26, 0.12)); border-radius: 24px; padding: 24px; background: var(--panel-bg, rgba(255, 250, 242, 0.82)); color: var(--color-text, #241f1a); box-shadow: var(--color-panel-shadow, 0 18px 40px rgba(78, 51, 34, 0.08)); backdrop-filter: blur(14px); font-family: 'Sora Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel-card h2 { margin: 0; font-family: 'Oxanium Variable', 'Sora Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0; } .ds-panel-card p { margin: 6px 0 0; color: var(--color-text-muted, rgba(36, 31, 26, 0.7)); line-height: 1.6; } .ds-eyebrow { font-family: 'Barlow Semi Condensed', 'Sora Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-accent-secondary, #9a4c33); font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Immersive HUD Item
components.description: Compact performance telemetry for play and free-play stages.
components.css: .ds-hud-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 1px; min-width: 0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 3px 9px; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45); color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95); backdrop-filter: blur(6px); } .ds-hud-item span { font-family: 'Barlow Semi Condensed', 'Sora Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6); } .ds-hud-item strong { font-family: 'Oxanium Variable', 'Sora Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95); text-shadow: 0 1px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6); }

components.name: Immersive Nav Pill
components.description: Scrollable HUD navigation for immersive play screens.
components.css: .ds-hud-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; overflow-x: auto; scrollbar-width: none; } .ds-hud-nav button { flex: 0 0 auto; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 9px; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.34); color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.76); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-hud-nav button:hover, .ds-hud-nav button:focus-visible { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14); color: #fff8ec; } .ds-hud-nav button.active { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent-secondary, #ff6b9d) 58%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent-secondary, #ff6b9d) 24%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.38)); color: #fff8ec; cursor: default; }

narrative.overview:
LumaKeys is the visible app identity for the PianoHero product brief: a focused practice stage where beginners and intermediate players can import songs, follow lessons, drill theory, and play freely without feeling like they are inside a school portal. The interface should feel like an instrument surface first and a software dashboard second. Musical action, feedback, timing, and progress sit closest to the user.

The system is dark-first for performance and free play, with light and warm themes available for calmer practice contexts. It earns its spectacle through musical feedback: falling notes, piano keys, HUD stats, menu cards, audio controls, and reward moments. Dense controls are allowed, but they must feel like a cockpit for practice, not an administrative form.
keyCharacteristics: Dark stage shells with illuminated controls, not ordinary web sections.
A restrained core UI vocabulary with vivid accents reserved for state, hand color, route identity, and rewards.
Rounded, tactile controls for regular app flow; clipped neon deck controls only where the screen is intentionally immersive.
Always-readable status text for users whose hands are busy at the keyboard.
Progressive complexity: start with play, reveal setup and tuning when needed.

rules.name: The Stage First Rule
rules.body: Gameplay, free play, soundboard, and menu surfaces must read as immersive environments before they read as pages.

rules.name: The Earned Neon Rule
rules.body: Saturated neon belongs to state, route identity, reward, or musical feedback. Inactive surfaces stay muted.

rules.name: The Hand Color Rule
rules.body: Left and right hand colors are functional identifiers. Never reuse the same pair for unrelated decorative accents on the same screen.

rules.name: The Hands-Busy Rule
rules.body: Text near performance controls must be short, high contrast, and scannable from a playing posture.

rules.name: The Display Reserve Rule
rules.body: Oxanium display scale is for stage identity and major state. Do not use hero-sized type inside settings cards, table rows, or compact controls.

rules.name: The Overlay Blur Rule
rules.body: Backdrop blur belongs to HUDs, popouts, topbars, and stage overlays. Do not apply blur to every card by default.

rules.name: The Lift Means Action Rule
rules.body: Translate and glow on hover only for clickable cards or controls. Static information panels should not jump.

dos: Do preserve the focused practice stage: musical action, score feedback, HUD stats, and keyboard state should stay visually closest to the learner.
Do use dark immersive surfaces for play, free play, soundboard, and main menu contexts.
Do keep setup and settings dense but controlled: group related controls, keep labels short, and reveal advanced options progressively.
Do keep exact functional colors consistent: success for completion, warning or gold for perfect and reward states, miss red for failure or danger.
Do respect the 780px mobile breakpoint by reducing columns, shrinking HUD items, and preventing text overlap.
Do support reduced motion by removing entrance animations and hover choreography where the stylesheet already provides a reduced-motion path.
donts: Don't make PianoHero feel like a generic website.
Don't make it feel like a school portal, worksheet app, or classroom software.
Don't make dense screens feel like an enterprise dashboard or administrative form.
Don't bury the player in configuration before they can play.
Don't use marketing-section composition for product screens. No landing-page card stacks, hero metrics, or decorative feature grids inside the app shell.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored side stripe on cards, alerts, or lists.
Don't add gradient text outside the existing main-menu title treatment. New text emphasis should use weight, size, or a single solid color.
Don't apply glassmorphism as a default card style. Blur must mean overlay, HUD, popout, or stage depth.
Don't use decorative motion that does not communicate hover, focus, selection, loading, reveal, timing, or musical feedback.
